commit.message:
README: correct attribution of the anti-diagonal F identity

Both the EML operator AND the anti-diagonal F identity
  e^x = (F(3x) − F(x) − log 3) / (F(2x) − F(x) − log 2) − 1
with F(x) = exp(x) + log(x) are due to Andrzej Odrzywołek — the former from
his EML paper, the latter from his subsequent May 2026 tweet announcement.

Previous attribution called this "an external source" which is imprecise:
it's not external, it's the same author whose EML paper this repo is built
around. Fixed in both the section header attribution and the bottom
Attribution block.
